name: mind-diary
description: Connect the Mind Diary UAT pilot and work with private, revisioned knowledge, including exact local files.

interface.shortDescription: Browse and update Minds, including exact local files.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the restricted Mind Diary UAT pilot with OAuth on first use. Attach explicit read-only Minds, choose one writable Mind, browse, search, fetch, validate, export and safely commit Markdown Memories or arbitrary regular BundleFiles. A bundled macOS companion keeps exact local paths inside one process, stream-hashes and uploads through a short-lived hosted intent without base64 or full-file buffering. Every write preserves immutable history and uses binding plus revision concurrency.
defaultPrompt: Show the Minds I can access
Search one Mind for a Memory
Add one exact local file to my Personal Mind
